title: Correct cf_tutor_completions.test.mjs's header comment to stop claiming tutorBulkPriorCompletions coverage

evidence.quote:
// CF tests — tutor completion mutations: tutorResetCompletion,
// tutorBulkPriorCompletions. See _cf_helpers.mjs for the harness.

why: A maintainer reading cf_tutor_completions.test.mjs to check or extend tutorBulkPriorCompletions coverage would find nothing there and might conclude it's untested (or add a duplicate suite) -- the real coverage lives in cf_tutor_settings_profile.test.mjs, a file whose name doesn't mention completions at all.
recommendation: Move the tutorBulkPriorCompletions describe block into cf_tutor_completions.test.mjs, or fix the header comments in both files to point to the actual location.
acceptance_criteria: Header comments in both files accurately state where tutorBulkPriorCompletions is tested.
